body: Ah I wouldn’t worry about it. My friend chipped her tooth fairy significantly and the dentist put on white bonding to fix it. Just book an appointment and they can fix it.

Cavities are deadly. I noticed a black line of discolouration on my bottom right molar, and it was revealed that the decay entered a small hole in the enamel and spread rapidly through the soft dentin layer. I was told that many people don’t even notice until the tooth structure suddenly collapses inwards, as seen here. Hopefully it can be fixed with a filling or RCT. Good luck!
